exposure: Intervention time for heterotopic caesarean scar pregnancy
outcome: Growth of residual mass after selective fetal reduction
cohort: Four patients diagnosed with heterotopic caesarean scar pregnancy (HCSP) from January 2014 to May 2019, and 27 published cases
finding: Earlier intervention for HCSP was associated with a higher full-term delivery rate, and selective fetal reduction appears to be a safe and effective treatment option.
